title: Contributor Launch 360 — Toolkit Playbook for Role Handoffs, Benefits, and Career Signposts
author: Ava Thompson
body:
SUMMARY
This playbook describes a standardized, cross-functional process we use at Redwood to launch contributors into productive roles quickly and safely. It ties together role handoffs, access to internal tools, benefits activation, and early career signposts. Audience: people-ops, hiring managers, engineering managers, ICs who are onboarding new contributors, and managers executing role transitions.

GOALS
- Reduce time to first meaningful PR or feature by 50% for technical hires.
- Ensure tooling and benefit entitlements are applied consistently within first 5 business days.
- Provide clear career signposts (30/90/180 day) to reduce role ambiguity and improve early retention.

SCOPE
This playbook covers:
- New hire (IC & manager) onboarding from offer acceptance through first 6 months.
- Role transitions (internal promotions, lateral moves) requiring access and privileges changes.
- Activation of benefits and payroll entitlements during first pay period.
- Tooling access flows for common services: GitHub, CI runners, Redwood Console, Slack, OKTA, GCP/AWS accounts for Private deployments.

OWNER & STAKEHOLDERS
- Owner: people-ops (Ava Thompson)
- Primary stakeholders: hiring manager (team), eng-dx (developer experience), infra (cloud-accounts), security (rbac-and-auth).

KEY DEFINITIONS
- Contributor Launch 360 (CL360): The combined workflow of role assignment, tool access, benefits activation, and career check-ins.
- Role Handoff: Formal transfer of responsibilities when someone leaves or moves teams.
- Privilege Window: A temporary elevated access period (max 72 hours) for onboarding engineers to run infra setup tasks under supervision.

QUICK START (one-page)
1) Offer accepted: people-ops triggers CL360 workflow in Workflows service (workflow-id: CL360-001).
2) Day 0 (before first day): create GitHub org access, Slack invite, OKTA identity, basic GSuite account.
3) Day 1–5: complete access checklist (sections below), schedule 30-day check-in with manager and peer buddy.
4) Day 30/90/180: run career signpost templates & update role expectations doc in team wiki.

DETAILED CHECKLIST (numbered tasks assigned to owners)
1. people-ops: Create employee record, initiate payroll and benefits enrollment (deadline: before end of first pay period).
2. security: Provision OKTA account, apply baseline RBAC groups (rbac: core-contributor, slack-basic).
3. eng-dx: Grant GitHub repo access (triage and owner repos), CI runner permissions, and sandbox AWS/GCP project with cost tags.
4. infra: If role requires Private deployment access, create VPC scoped service account and add to project-level IAM with least privilege.
5. manager: Assign first sprint ticket, schedule role expectations meeting, introduce to peer buddy.
6. peer buddy: Run tooling walkthrough (Git cloning, local dev sandbox, Redwood Console walkthrough).
7. people-ops + manager: Confirm benefits enrollment and equipment procurement (laptop, docking) within week 1.

ACCESS MATRIX (text table)
Service | Typical first-day entitlement | Provisioning owner | SLA
GitHub (org) | read + repo triage | eng-dx | 4 hours
Redwood Console (dev) | view + token creation | eng-dx | 8 hours
CI runners | submit jobs (non-privileged) | eng-dx | 24 hours
OKTA | identity + 2FA | security | 2 hours
GCP/AWS sandbox | limited project access | infra | 48 hours
Hardware (laptop) | issued | people-ops | 5 business days
Benefits enrollment | initiated | people-ops | 3 business days

PRIVILEGE WINDOWS
- Use case: infra bootstrapping, secrets migration, on-prem install validation.
- Max duration: 72 hours.
- Approval flow: manager -> infra owner -> security reviewer. Approval recorded in the CL360 ticket.
- Rollback: infra must provide automated rollback playbook and test run before window can be granted.

ROLE HANDOFF CHECKLIST (when an incumbent leaves or changes role)
1) Manager files a Role Handoff Request in the RoleOps queue (template: role-handoff-YYYYMMDD).
2) people-ops schedules knowledge transfer sessions (min 2 hours) and documents runbooks in team wiki.
3) eng-dx reassigns repo ownership and updates CODEOWNERS.
4) infra removes elevated privileges and runs an access audit (using AccessAudit tool, export saved to payroll-archive).
5) Security issues final sign-off and closes the handoff ticket.

CAREER SIGNPOSTS (templates & outcomes)
- 30-day: "Foundations" — checklist includes merged PR, completed onboarding tasks, first documentation contribution. Manager outcome: alignment on short-term goals.
- 90-day: "Execution" — deliverable ownership, cross-team collaboration evidence, feedback conversation. Manager outcome: discuss development plan and ladder fit.
- 180-day: "Trajectory" — demonstrable impact, promotion calibration if applicable, stretch assignments. Manager outcome: confirm next 6–12 month objectives.

MANAGER GUIDANCE: ROLE EXPECTATIONS TEMPLATE (fill-in)
- Role name, level and band: ______
- Key deliverables (first 90 days): 1) ______ 2) ______ 3) ______
- Success metrics (OKRs / metrics): ______
- Buddy and stakeholders: ______
- Access required: ______

BENEFITS ACTIVATION (procedural steps)
1) people-ops enters hire into Benefits Portal and sends enrollment email within 24 hours of start.
2) New hire completes forms; people-ops confirms enrollment and sends confirmation.
3) For equipment stipends, people-ops issues a voucher and shipping schedule.
4) For international hires, payroll and tax team coordinate local onboarding (timeline: up to 14 days).

EXAMPLE SCRIPTS & SNIPPETS
- CLI: Create basic sandbox project (GCP example)
```
# run as infra-assist role
gcloud projects create redwood-sandbox-{{employee-id}} --name="sandbox-{{employee-name}}"
gcloud iam service-accounts create sandbox-builder --display-name="Sandbox Builder"
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding redwood-sandbox-{{employee-id}} --member="serviceAccount:sandbox-builder@redwood-sandbox-{{employee-id}}.iam.gserviceaccount.com" --role="roles/viewer"
```
- YAML: Example onboarding ticket payload for Workflows service
```
workflow: CL360-001
assignee: people-ops
employee_id: E-12345
start_date: 2026-01-05
role: Software Engineer II
required_tooling: [github,okta,redwood-console,ci]
```

ESCALATION PATHS
- Day 0–5 access failure: escalate to eng-dx on-call (rota: eng-dx-oncall@redwood.com).
- Benefits not applied by first pay: people-ops escalation to HR lead (hr-lead@redwood.com) and finance.
- Privilege window misuse: security incident process (see Security IR runbook) — immediate suspension and audit.

METRICS & HEALTH DASHBOARD (for people-ops)
- Time-to-first-merge (target: <= 14 days)
- Percentage of hires with full access by day 5 (target: 95%)
- Benefits enrollment completion rate by first pay period (target: 100%)
- Role handoff completeness score (manual audit quarterly, target: 90%)

FAQ
Q: Who is responsible for laptop shipping delays?
A: people-ops owns procurement; infra supports temporary remote development images until hardware arrives.

Q: How do I request a privilege window?
A: Use the RoleOps ticket template and attach the infra rollback playbook. Approval chain: manager -> infra -> security.

Q: Can a contractor receive the same benefits?
A: Contractors receive a subset of the benefits; refer to contract-specific entitlements in the Benefits Portal.
